title: IR walker and pass manager
goal: Record the established verified IR traversal foundation.
description: StyioIRWalker centralizes traversal and the pass manager supports opt-level selection with verification before and after pass execution.

acceptance_criteria.text: The current-state authority records Checkpoint A as complete.

title: Span-first tokenizer
goal: Record the established linear tokenization foundation.
description: The tokenizer uses span-first O(n) scanning, CreateFromSpan, constexpr operator dispatch, and focused span/performance regressions.

acceptance_criteria.text: The current-state authority records Checkpoint B as complete.

title: Parser core unification
goal: Unify expression parsing through the accepted precedence authority.
description: Compare mature Pratt or precedence-climbing implementations, then preserve accepted grammar, diagnostics, associativity, bounded stack depth, and zero-fallback parser authority.

acceptance_criteria.text: C0 readiness, precedence goldens, parser equivalence, shadow, zero-fallback, complexity, memory, and deep-expression evidence are frozen before implementation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: OPT-C design and executable acceptance matrix are frozen before production implementation.

title: Verified IR optimization passes
goal: Close one measured optimization-pass family at a time.
description: Compare production compiler passes and select the simplest StyioIR worklist, lattice, cache, and invalidation strategy that demonstrates semantic equivalence and measurable value.

acceptance_criteria.text: The first pass family has verifier, semantic-equivalence, compile-time, runtime, allocation, and external benchmark criteria before implementation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Frozen OPT-D architecture and validation define verifier, equivalence, compile-time, runtime, allocation, and benchmark criteria before production implementation.

title: Bounded type constraint engine
goal: Consolidate type solving without erasing handle or representation facts.
description: Compare mature type solvers and freeze a terminating worklist, union-find, memoization, or SCC strategy with deterministic diagnostics and bounded recomputation.

acceptance_criteria.text: The selected type-solver slice defines termination, canonical ownership, diagnostics, allocation, cache, invalidation, and focused regression evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Frozen OPT-E architecture and validation define termination, canonical ownership, diagnostics, allocation, cache invalidation, and focused regression evidence.

title: Resource typestate and dataflow
goal: Advance one canonical resource typestate/dataflow slice.
description: Preserve active syntax and one topology authority while comparing mature ownership/dataflow analyses for graph representation, joins, convergence, invalidation, and memory bounds.

acceptance_criteria.text: One resource scenario defines typestate transitions, convergence, negative migration diagnostics, security evidence, and bounded memory behavior.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: OPT-F design freezes one acquired-file conditional-close typestate scenario with deterministic joins, diagnostics, security evidence, and bounded memory counters.

title: Stream concurrency semantics
description: Compare structured-concurrency and bounded-channel implementations, then define queue, wake-up, cancellation, race safety, backpressure, and memory behavior without reviving retired routes.

acceptance_criteria.text: One active-syntax stream scenario has parser-through-runtime, race/sanitizer, cancellation, bounded-queue, backpressure, and five-layer evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Deterministic zip facts and bounded task scheduling groups provide active syntax through runtime, exact bounded queue/pressure, shutdown close, MPMC race, and ASan/UBSan evidence.
